nph.text: Vryn is where Ranna gave birth to Jace in 4534 AR, and after Jace's presumed death she drank and split from Gav, then joined the army as a field medic and took part in the defense of Vryn.
Jace planeswalked into her living room with Vraska to escape their wounds and compleation, and after Jace was shattered, Vraska and Loot stayed with Ranna to mourn.
Chandra and Ajani arrived to tell Vraska that Jace was alive and trying to overlay the Echoverse.
